Colour & atmosphere

The Emerald Room

Deep green, soft daylight and a quiet sense of belonging.

Illustrative concept

Let the colour set the pace.

A green kitchen can feel cocooning without feeling closed in. Balance the deeper cabinet tone with a lighter wall and keep the largest surfaces calm, so the room has space to breathe.

Before choosing a finish, look at samples in your own room at different times of day. Warm metal details and natural textures can soften the palette; a limited selection keeps the overall composition clear.
